name: Mausoleum at Halicarnassus
description: The tomb of Mausolus at Halicarnassus around 350 BCE: a high podium, a ring of Ionic columns, a stepped pyramid roof and a marble chariot on top. Scopabubu the sculptor tells its story.

spawns.default: In the courtyard south of the Mausoleum, facing it
spawns.from_square: In front of the portal back to Metaverse Square, facing into the world

portals.label: Metaverse Square
portals.where: A glowing pink doorway near where you arrive
